scripts.dev:backend: uv run --directory backend python -m uvicorn app.main:application --reload
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && uv run --directory backend python -m ruff check . && uv run --directory backend python -m ruff format --check . && uv run --directory backend python -m mypy app
scripts.test: npm test --workspaces --if-present && uv run --directory backend python -m pytest
scripts.verifier: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.start: uv run --directory backend python -m uvicorn app.main:application
